name: Tooga's Quest
summary: In Tanaris, you and Tooga are trying to reach Torta. She waits just south of Steamwheedle Port.

sections.title: A Lost Wanderer
sections.body: Tooga wanders near a crashed goblin zeppelin by Thistleshrub Valley, unsure of the way home. His wife, Torta, sent him to fetch dinner. A wrong turn left him lost, so he asks you to lead him back to her.

sections.title: Across the Zone
sections.body: Torta waits just south of Steamwheedle Port, across Tanaris from Tooga. Reaching her means walking nearly the whole width of the zone.

sections.title: A Wife's Welcome
sections.body: Torta is not surprised that Tooga could not find his way home alone. She tells him to go into the ocean and bring back food.

aliases: who is the turtle in tanaris
faq.answer: Tooga is a lost turtle in Tanaris who needs help finding his way back to his wife.
Torta is Tooga's wife, waiting just south of Steamwheedle Port.

faq.q: Why is Tooga lost in the desert?
faq.answer: Torta sent Tooga to fetch dinner, but a wrong turn left him lost.
Tooga is found near a crashed goblin zeppelin by Thistleshrub Valley in Tanaris.
